name: R1 plus Lex's two research previews as tilts on the Bitcoin sleeve
author: Lex (the previews and their thresholds: channel divergence, late-cycle signals). Rule form and the 0.80 threshold on the three non-concentration gauges: Claude, 2026-10-08.
description: R1, plus two tilts that only act in risk_on. Channel divergence (macro panel > 0.70 while BTC beta < 0.5x its trailing 3-year median, or BTC/QQQ percentile < 0.30, or stablecoin-minus-QQQ 90-day flow negative for 90 days): the Bitcoin sleeve takes the neutral weight. Late cycle (at least 3 of 4 gauges above the 0.80 percentile: SPY/RSP concentration, S-4 deal count, margin-debt YoY, consumer confidence): the Bitcoin sleeve moves halfway back to neutral. Freed weight goes to the yield book pro rata.
label: composite

tilts.reason: The on-chain panel reads crypto activity in isolation; when the macro tailwind is not reaching crypto, the composite overstates risk-on for Bitcoin (channel-divergence preview).
A loud risk-on composite with saturated late-cycle gauges is where trimming into strength beats chasing (late-cycle preview).
